identity.name: Active Directory Offline-Roasting Credential Harvest — AS-REP Roast + Kerberoast (T1558.004 / T1558.003)
identity.summary: Against the authorised CortexSim AD lab, an operator harvests crackable Kerberos material two ways: impacket-GetNPUsers pulls an AS-REP for the pre-auth-disabled helpdesk-admin account (AS-REP Roasting), and impacket-GetUserSPNs requests TGS tickets for the SPN-bearing service accounts (Kerberoasting). Cortex ITDR fires BIOCs on the pre-auth AS-REQ, the SPN LDAP sweep, and the RC4 TGS-REQ burst.
identity.description: Offline roasting is the lowest-friction credential-access path in Active Directory because it requires only a valid (or, for AS-REP, no) domain context and yields a hash crackable entirely offline — no lateral movement, no malware on the DC. This card reproduces both roasting families against the deliberately-misconfigured CortexSim AD lab (the `itdr` IaC module seeds five SPN-bearing service accounts — sql-svc, web-svc, bkp-svc, ora-svc, app-svc — with the weak password `Summer2024`, and one Domain-Admin-equivalent account, helpdesk-admin, with DoesNotRequirePreAuth set). AS-REP Roasting (T1558.004): impacket-GetNPUsers asks the KDC for an AS-REP for helpdesk-admin; because Kerberos pre-authentication is disabled, the KDC returns an AS-REP whose encrypted part is a crackable hash of the account password — observable as an AS-REQ for a pre-auth-disabled principal and (on a 4768 audit) an unusual pre-auth type. Kerberoasting (T1558.003): impacket-GetUserSPNs first issues an LDAP query filtered on servicePrincipalName=* to enumerate roastable accounts (the recon tell ITDR keys on), then requests RC4-encrypted TGS service tickets for each SPN, producing a burst of Kerberos 4769 TGS-REQ events for multiple service principals from one source. Both hashes are cracked offline (simulated here — no real cracking) and the cracked credential becomes the pivot for the separate lateral-movement chain (SIM-MP-002). The detection model is identity-behavioural: (1) a BIOC fires on an AS-REQ / 4768 for an account flagged DoesNotRequirePreAuth; (2) a BIOC fires on a servicePrincipalName LDAP sweep from a non-DC, non-admin host; (3) a BIOC fires on a 4769 TGS-REQ burst requesting RC4 (etype 0x17) tickets for multiple distinct SPNs from one source; validation XQL confirms each, the NGFW XQL confirms the port-88 spike, and a correlation rule groups AS-REP + Kerberoast from one source into a single Credential Access incident. This card is the dedicated single-plane ITDR roasting scenario; the cross-plane Kerberoast→PtH→DCSync chain remains TTP-2026-0063 / SIM-MP-002.

techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: AS-REP Roasting
Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting

data_sources: Active Directory: Active Directory Object Access

prerequisites.description: Cortex ITDR connected to the Active Directory domain (security event + LDAP/Kerberos telemetry) on the authorised CortexSim AD lab.
Lab matching the `itdr` IaC module: seeded SPN-bearing service accounts (sql-svc/web-svc/bkp-svc/ora-svc/app-svc) and the pre-auth-disabled helpdesk-admin account.

payload.code:
# All activity targets the authorised CortexSim itdr-module AD lab.
# AS-REP Roast: pull a crackable AS-REP for the pre-auth-disabled DA-equivalent account.
impacket-GetNPUsers cortexsim.local/ -no-pass -usersfile helpdesk-admin -dc-ip 10.0.10.10 -request
# Kerberoast: enumerate SPNs then request RC4 TGS tickets for every service account.
impacket-GetUserSPNs cortexsim.local/Administrator:$ADMIN_PWD -dc-ip 10.0.10.10 -request

expected_artifacts.description: Kerberos AS-REQ (4768) for an account flagged DoesNotRequirePreAuth (AS-REP Roasting).
LDAP search with a servicePrincipalName filter from a non-DC host (Kerberoast recon).
Burst of Kerberos 4769 TGS-REQ requesting RC4 (etype 0x17) for multiple service principals from one source.
Spike of outbound Kerberos (TCP/UDP 88) sessions from the operator host to the DC.

cleanup.code: echo '[CortexSim] SIM-ITDR-006 cleanup complete — removing simulated roast artifacts'; rm -f /tmp/cortexsim_itdr006_asrep.txt /tmp/cortexsim_itdr006_tgs.txt

biocs.name: ITDR-006 AS-REQ For Pre-Auth-Disabled Account (AS-REP Roast)
biocs.description: ITDR - a Kerberos AS-REQ / 4768 is observed for a domain account whose userAccountControl has DoesNotRequirePreAuth set. Requesting an AS-REP for such an account returns a crackable hash with no prior authentication — the AS-REP Roasting fingerprint (T1558.004).
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY
| filter event_id = 4768
| filter pre_authentication_type = 0
| filter src_host not in ("DC01", "DC02")
| fields _time, account_name, src_host, pre_authentication_type

biocs.name: ITDR-006 LDAP SPN Sweep From Non-Typical Host
biocs.description: ITDR - LDAP search filter (servicePrincipalName=*) from a host that is not a domain controller and not an established admin workstation — the enumeration that precedes Kerberoasting (T1558.003).
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY
| filter operation_name in ("LDAP_SEARCH", "DirectorySearch")
| filter lower(search_filter) contains "serviceprincipalname"
| filter src_host not in ("DC01", "DC02")
| filter actor_effective_username not in ("Administrator", "svc-bloodhound")
| fields _time, src_host, actor_effective_username, search_filter

biocs.name: ITDR-006 Kerberos TGS-REQ RC4 Burst For Multiple SPNs
biocs.description: ITDR - a single source requests RC4-encrypted (etype 0x17) TGS service tickets (4769) for three or more distinct service principals in a short window — the Kerberoasting ticket-harvest fingerprint (T1558.003). RC4 is requested because its TGS is the easiest to crack offline.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY
| filter event_id = 4769
| filter ticket_encryption_type = "0x17"
| bin _time span=5m
| comp count_distinct(service_name) as spn_count by src_host, actor_effective_username, _time
| filter spn_count >= 3
| fields _time, src_host, actor_effective_username, spn_count

xql_queries.name: ITDR-006 Validate AS-REP Roast AS-REQ For Pre-Auth-Disabled Account
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY
| filter event_id = 4768 and pre_authentication_type = 0
| comp count() as asrep_requests by account_name, src_host
| filter asrep_requests >= 1
| fields account_name, src_host, asrep_requests

xql_queries.name: ITDR-006 Validate Kerberoast TGS-REQ RC4 Burst
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY
| filter event_id = 4769 and ticket_encryption_type = "0x17"
| comp count_distinct(service_name) as spn_count by src_host, actor_effective_username
| filter spn_count >= 3
| fields src_host, actor_effective_username, spn_count

xql_queries.name: ITDR-006 NGFW Kerberos Port 88 Traffic Spike From Operator Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dst_port = 88
| filter app in ("kerberos", "ms-kerberos") or proto in ("tcp", "udp")
| comp count(session_id) as kerb_sessions by source_ip, dest_ip
| filter kerb_sessions >= 5
| fields source_ip, dest_ip, kerb_sessions

xql_queries.name: ITDR-006 Hunt All Roastable Principals Targeted From One Source
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 86400)
| filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY
| filter event_id in (4768, 4769)
| comp count_distinct(service_name) as spns_targeted, count_distinct(account_name) as accounts_targeted by src_host
| sort desc spns_targeted
| fields src_host, spns_targeted, accounts_targeted

correlation_rules.name: AD Offline-Roasting Credential Harvest From One Source
correlation_rules.logic: (BIOC(ITDR-006 AS-REQ For Pre-Auth-Disabled Account (AS-REP Roast)) OR BIOC(ITDR-006 Kerberos TGS-REQ RC4 Burst For Multiple SPNs)) AND BIOC(ITDR-006 LDAP SPN Sweep From Non-Typical Host) — groups AS-REP Roasting and Kerberoasting harvesting from one source host into a single Credential Access incident.

analytics_modules.note: Backed by BIOC 'ITDR-006 Kerberos TGS-REQ RC4 Burst For Multiple SPNs' + its validation XQL on this card.

analytics_modules.note: Backed by BIOC 'ITDR-006 AS-REQ For Pre-Auth-Disabled Account' + its validation XQL on this card.

products.evidence_query: dataset = xdr_data | filter event_type = ENUM.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY | filter (event_id = 4768 and pre_authentication_type = 0) or (event_id = 4769 and ticket_encryption_type = "0x17") | fields _time, account_name, src_host, service_name
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw | filter dst_port = 88 | comp count(session_id) as sessions by source_ip, dest_ip
Correlation CR-ITDR-0006 groups AS-REP Roasting and Kerberoasting from one source host into a single Credential Access incident.
Playbook: disable the targeted roastable accounts, force a long random password / gMSA rotation, and enable Kerberos pre-auth.

threat_scenarios.name: Active Directory Offline Roasting — AS-REP Roast + Kerberoast Harvest
threat_scenarios.description: Detect both offline-roasting credential-access families (AS-REP Roasting and Kerberoasting) when harvested from a single source against the seeded AD lab, and group them into one Credential Access incident.

threat_steps.objective: AS-REP Roast and Kerberoast each fire their ITDR detection during SIM-ITDR-006.
preconditions: Cortex ITDR connected to AD with the seeded pre-auth-disabled and SPN-bearing accounts.
BIOCs from this card imported and enabled.
steps: Run SIM-ITDR-006 steps 1-3 against the seeded lab.
Observe the AS-REP, SPN-sweep, and TGS-REQ-burst ITDR detections in the Cortex console.
success_criteria: BIOC `ITDR-006 AS-REQ For Pre-Auth-Disabled Account (AS-REP Roast)` fires on the AS-REP harvest step.
BIOC `ITDR-006 Kerberos TGS-REQ RC4 Burst For Multiple SPNs` fires with spn_count >= 3.
All three XQL validation queries return >= 1 row.

threat_steps.objective: Both roasting techniques stitch into one Credential Access incident.
success_criteria: Correlation `CR-ITDR-0006` groups the AS-REP + Kerberoast signals from one source into a single incident.

preventive_controls: Set long (25+ character) random passwords or use group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA) for all SPN-bearing service accounts so a roasted TGS is uncrackable.
Enable Kerberos pre-authentication on every account and audit for the DoesNotRequirePreAuth flag.
Disable RC4 for Kerberos and require AES, removing the cheap-to-crack TGS encryption type.
Restrict and monitor who can read servicePrincipalName attributes across the directory.
detection_engineering: Alert on AS-REQ / 4768 events for accounts flagged DoesNotRequirePreAuth.
Alert on LDAP searches filtering servicePrincipalName from non-DC, non-admin hosts.
Alert on a burst of 4769 TGS-REQ requesting RC4 (etype 0x17) for multiple SPNs from a single source.
Correlate AS-REP Roasting and Kerberoasting from one source into a single Credential Access incident.

changelog.change: GAP-ADAPT-02: dedicated single-plane ITDR offline-roasting card for SIM-ITDR-006 — AS-REP Roast (T1558.004) + Kerberoast (T1558.003) harvest against the itdr-module seeded lab. Real ITDR AS-REQ / SPN-sweep / RC4-TGS-burst BIOCs+XQL, NGFW port-88 XQL, correlation CR-ITDR-0006, GAP-11 validated/unvalidated analytics split. Wired to the adapter-gated SIM-ITDR-006 scenario (TOOL-IMPACKET / TOOL-RUBEUS).
